script_text: Most astrologers call Aries‑Cancer a disaster, but the real story hides in the 1st‑7th house axis. Aries’ fire meets Cancer’s water, creating a steam‑cloud that can either fuel passion or douse it. The Mars‑ruled Aries Sun in the 1st house squares the Moon‑ruled Cancer Moon in the 7th, so friction is built‑in. Venus in Cancer trines Cancer’s Moon, drawing Aries toward nurturing intimacy. Yet Aries’ Mars in Leo squares that Venus, sparking sudden arguments over independence. Mercury in Gemini sits in Aries’ 3rd house while Cancer’s Mercury in Cancer occupies the 4th. Words fly fast for Aries but linger emotionally for Cancer, causing misread signals. Saturn in Pisces sextiles Cancer’s Moon and trines Aries’ Midheaven in the 10th. This promises long‑term stability if both honor the emotional contract. The make‑or‑break key: Aries must pause before reacting, letting Cancer’s lunar rhythm set the pace. Comment your partner's sign!
